title: Theme from "Ah, vous dirai-je, Maman", K. 265
source: Notes checked on 18 Nov 2026 against a public-domain typeset in the Mutopia Project (J. J. Olson's two-guitar edition, which states it follows Mozart's theme exactly apart from the low C in bars 1, 8, 17 and 24, restored here). Second-hand source: compare once with a piano score before printing. Trills in bars 15 and 23 omitted.
print_source: Mozart's own theme from the Twelve Variations on "Ah, vous dirai-je, Maman", K. 265 (published 1785). Trills omitted.
